name: outcome
description: How the call ended. booked = a consultation was booked on the call via the booking tool; link_sent = the booking link was sent instead; callback_requested = they asked to be rung back; not_interested = they declined; not_a_gp = not a doctor / not a GP; wrong_number = wrong person; already_booked = they had already booked; voicemail = voicemail or answering machine; no_answer = nobody spoke; unclear = a person spoke but none of the above clearly applies.

name: callback_time
description: If they asked to be called back, when, in their own words. Empty otherwise.

name: gp_status
description: Whether they are a practising GP (gp), still in GP training (trainee), not a GP at all (not_a_gp), or it never came up (unknown).

name: training_finish
description: If still in training, when they said they finish, in their words. Empty otherwise.

name: timeframe
description: When they said they want to move to Australia, in their words. Empty if not discussed.
examples: in two years once the kids finish school

name: objections
description: Comma-separated list of the concerns or objections the doctor raised, from: timing, partner, money, moving_costs, remote, city_only, part_time, english_test, old_mrcgp, overseas_trained, other_agency, scam, in_writing, process, family_school, elderly_parents, undecided_country, ai_suspicion, none.

name: objection_handled
description: For the main concern raised: did the agent answer it with a specific reason or workaround (handled), only partly or vaguely (partly), ignore it or just repeat the offer (ignored), or no concern was raised (none).

name: lost_booking_reason
description: If the doctor was a practising GP (or within three months of finishing) and did not end up booked or sent the link, one sentence on what the agent said or failed to say that cost the booking. Empty if booked, link sent, or not a bookable doctor.
examples: Doctor asked for written info first; agent offered a time instead of saying it is in the confirmation email.

name: unanswered_questions
description: Questions the doctor asked that the agent did not answer or answered wrongly, each in a few words, comma-separated. Empty if none.
examples: school fees for dependants, whether Perth has openings

name: agent_slips
description: Any of these the agent did: repeated a question, asked two questions at once, used filler like 'great question', mentioned rules or tools, said 'fully qualified', asked whether they are a GP, quoted a salary figure, claimed anyone is fully booked, gave a second goodbye. Comma-separated short labels, or 'none'.
examples: repeated question, two questions at once

name: notes
description: One or two sentences a human recruiter needs before the consultation: family situation, preferred locations, concerns raised, questions left unanswered.
examples: Partner is a nurse, two kids, wants Queensland coast. Asked about school fees, not answered.
